tools.name: everaw_check_allergens
tools.description: Check which allergens an Everaw product contains, and whether it is made in a facility that handles nuts. Use this whenever someone asks about nuts, peanuts, allergies or whether a product is safe for an allergic child. Pass a product name, or "all" to list every product. Returns plain text: product name, an allergen line naming tree nuts or peanuts where present, the shared-facility statement, and ingredients. For "all", two named groups plus that statement.

product.description: Product name, or "all" for the whole range.

tools.name: everaw_find_by_dietary_need
tools.description: Find Everaw products matching a dietary requirement: no nuts, no added sugar, vegan, gluten free, or suitable for children. Use this when someone describes a need rather than naming a product, for example "something nut free for my toddler". Returns plain text: for no-nuts the shared-facility caveat comes FIRST, then one line per match as "- Name (price INR): url". Relay the caveat, it qualifies every item listed.

need.description: The dietary requirement to match against.

tools.name: everaw_lab_reports
tools.description: Report whether an Everaw product has been independently laboratory tested, and point to the published reports. Use this when someone asks if the products are tested, verified, third party checked, or whether the published nutrition can be trusted. Pass a product name, or "all" for the range. Returns plain text: whether the product is independently tested, the report date if any, and the URL of the published reports. Says so plainly when none exists.

tools.name: everaw_product_facts
tools.description: Get the factual details of one Everaw product: ingredients, allergens, net weight, serving size, shelf life and storage. Use this for questions about what is in a product or how long it keeps. Does not cover price or stock, which come from the Shopify catalog tools. Returns plain text, one field per line: name, ingredients, allergens with the facility statement, dietary claims, weight and serving, shelf life, usage, URL.
